text.en:
While at 3 stacks, hip-firing a fully-drawn arrow spawns a Guidance Ring.

Guidance Ring lasts 20 seconds and will rotate in place to face you. Only one Guidance Ring can exist at a time.

Firing any fully-drawn arrow through the Guidance Ring triggers 3 additional seeking projectiles, each dealing <pve 192 /> <pvp [15] /> damage. Seekers gain <pve 50% /> <pvp [15-20%] /> increased damage past 40 meters and have a maximum range of 80 meters.

Guidance Rings grant their benefits to any Combat Bow, including <yellow Exotics />, Heavy Crossbows, <void/>Shadowshot, and also <yellow Buried Bloodline />.

While at 3 stacks, hip-firing a fully-drawn arrow spawns a Guidance Ring.

Guidance Ring lasts 20 seconds and will rotate in place to face you. Only one Guidance Ring per-guardian can exist at a time, but up to 3 Guidance Rings can exist across a fireteam. Each Guidance Ring can stack.

Firing any fully-drawn arrow through the Guidance Ring triggers several additional seeking projectiles, each dealing <pve 192 /> <pvp [15] /> damage. Seekers gain <pve 50% /> <pvp [15-20%] /> increased damage past 40 meters and have a maximum range of 80 meters.

Each seeker applies 15 <solar/>Scorch (20 with <solar/>Ember of Ashes) and deals <bold Weapon-Element Matching /> Explosive Damage in a 4 meter radius.

Guidance Rings grant their benefits to any Combat Bow, including Legendaries, <yellow Exotics />, Heavy Crossbows, <void/>Shadowshot, and also <yellow Buried Bloodline />. 

Arrows fired by Hierarchy of Needs release three seekers, while most other bows release two. Casting <void/>Shadowshot: Deadfall releases six.
